text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I got so carried away shopping that I'm 
running late! I'm barely going to make it 
in time for training!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, oh? I wonder what this sign is 
for...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Special Limited Lecture: How to 
Distinguish Between Fur Seals, Earless 
Seals, and Sea Lions"...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so curious...! But training is about 
to start, but...! B-But...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—And, unable to resist temptation, I 
listened to the very end. I am terribly 
sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Regardless of the training session's 
contents, she seemed genuinely remorseful, 
so I kept it to a light warning."
